text: Funds in program element 0603176BR Project RR were realigned to Project RR in PE 0603160BR during FY 2025 to better integrate this activity administratively into the RDT&E portfolio.

This effort was consolidated from PE 0602182A (C3I Applied Research) / Project CX3 (Intelligent Env Battlefield Awareness Apl Tech) to combine advanced terrain modeling and intel capabilities into a project.
SLCM funds were transferred to new PE 0105519N starting in FY 2026.
This effort was consolidated from PE 0602144A (Ground Technology) / Project DI7 to combine related work.
Funds were transferred to the contractor in FY 2025 to accelerate integration.
Project 016, Close Combat Lethality, moved to the Soldier Lethality Cross Functional Team.
